title: The PE Paradox: Volatility Fuels New Deals as Old Assets Sit Frozen in Portfolios

title: Jack Daniel’s Maker Turns Down Rival’s Takeover Bid
title_zh: 杰克丹尼的制造商拒绝了竞争对手的收购要约
summary: Jack Daniel’s maker Brown-Forman rejected a roughly $15 billion takeover offer from rival Sazerac, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，Jack Daniel 的制造商 Brown-Forman 拒绝了竞争对手 Sazerac 提出的约 150 亿美元的收购要约。
